svg.title: F-04: Live scoreboard
svg.desc: scoring. A Postgres view scores solve points minus intel spent, with ties broken by time. The page shows a podium and a score timeline, and leaves out admins, banned and hidden responders. Tags: postgres view, chart.js. 1,400 points on the board.
